section_summary.extract_value: This section describes ethics approval and opportunistic recruitment of participants in several public locations in Greater London by six researchers, with written informed consent obtained. Participants completed an anonymous paper-and-pencil survey in a quiet location and received a debriefing sheet; no sample size, demographics, measurement instruments (BAS/BAS-2), BMI assessment method, or correlations are reported. The text does not mention 'Study 1' or multiple studies.
